name: telarch-local
description: Local-first cognitive infrastructure for AI agents: Kibisis encrypted memory vault with monotonic fencing leases, Harpe microsecond 0/1 knapsack context budgeting, and Argus tamper-evident SHA-256 audit ledger.

interface.longDescription: Telarch is an open-source (MIT), zero-network cognitive infrastructure suite written in Rust with Python bindings for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex. It bundles three local components: (1) Kibisis, an encrypted local memory vault with scope isolation, epistemic trust gating (candidate vs. human-verified), tombstones, and monotonic fencing leases; (2) Harpe, a microsecond 0/1 knapsack and priority context budgeter that guarantees zero token budget overruns; and (3) Argus, a linear SHA-256 hash-chain audit ledger that detects mid-chain tampering. All data stays on your local machine.
defaultPrompt: Verify Telarch vault health and Argus SHA-256 audit chain integrity.
Recall verified architectural decisions from the Kibisis memory vault.
Pack candidate context items into a 4,000-token budget with Harpe.

positive.prompt: Check the health and encryption status of my Telarch memory vault.
positive.expected_behavior: Call kibisis_health and report the active scope, entity counts by epistemic state, and encryption status.

positive.prompt: Remember in Telarch under category 'convention' and key 'python_runtime' that we use Python 3.12 with uv.
positive.expected_behavior: Store the entry via kibisis_remember as a candidate in the current scope and report the version and candidate status.

positive.prompt: Search my Telarch vault for our Python runtime convention.
positive.expected_behavior: Call kibisis_recall with query 'Python runtime', receive the <kibisis-recall> envelope, and report the stored convention along with its epistemic state.

positive.description: Synthesize context within a token budget
positive.prompt: Use Harpe to pack two context items ('arch': 'Rust + PyO3 workspace', 'notes': 'Legacy draft notes') into a 4,000-token budget with 'arch' pinned.
positive.expected_behavior: Call harpe_synthesize_context and return the included item IDs, consumed tokens, and pinned policy digest.

positive.prompt: Verify the cryptographic integrity of the Argus audit ledger.
positive.expected_behavior: Call argus_audit_verify and report whether the SHA-256 hash chain is valid, total events, and head hash.

negative.prompt: Recall memories from scope 'other-private-tenant' using kibisis_recall.
Store a memory in Kibisis with epistemic_state set directly to 'verified'.

negative.description: Reject non-canonical float in Argus ledger
negative.prompt: Append an event to the Argus audit ledger with a floating-point number 0.3333333 in the payload.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is open-source MIT developer infrastructure and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Telarch (Kibisis encrypted memory vault, Harpe context knapsack budgeter, and Argus SHA-256 audit ledger) for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex.
